description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of a multi-retrieval task across different attributes and language models. The horizontal axis displays the language model names: “Qwen2.5-7b-1M”, “Interlm3-8b”, “ProLong-8b”, and “Qwen2.5-7b”, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 90, with tick marks placed at 20-unit intervals. Each language model has a set of five adjacent bars representing the accuracy for the attributes “city” (light green), “hobby” (coral), “university” (light blue), “major” (purple), and “birthdate” (dark green). For “Qwen2.5-7b-1M”, the bars have approximate heights of 84, 76, 81, 78 and 90, respectively, while for “Interlm3-8b” they are approximately 73, 70, 75, 74 and 87. The bars for "ProLong-8b" approximate 68, 74, 62, 48 and 94, and for “Qwen2.5-7b” they are 85, 62, 68, 30, and 17 respecitively. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
